author: Stahly
description:
This year AK Interactive overhauled and expanded its range of adhesives. The Spanish hobby manufacturer now has an impressive 19 products in its lineup for every possible use case. I tested all of them and I'll tell you which glues you actually need and which ones are more of a gimmick.

The post Do you really need 19 different glues? AK thinks so (full range review) appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Do you really need 19 different glues? AK thinks so (full range review)
